results.name: Silky Moving Background
results.description: Animated WebGL shader background in the Silk style. Generated by the 21st.dev Shader Builder. 4-color palette (#1A1423, #B75D69, #EACDC2, #FFF5EB). Features: cursor-reactive (swirl). A drop-in, zero-dependency React component for hero sections and animated gradient/noise backgrounds.
results.author: adamstguide
